sloka: बाष्प वेगम् तु सहसा नदी वेगम् इव आगतम् ।धारयामास धैर्येण सुग्रीवः राम संनिधौ ॥४-८-३०॥
transliteration: bāṣpa vegam tu sahasā nadī vegam iva āgatam ।dhārayāmāsa dhairyeṇa sugrīvaḥ rāma saṁnidhau ॥4-8-30॥

translations.english: Quickly Sugriva controlled his tears streaming fast like the rushing river, with patience, Rama seated in front.
